custom_logic_notes: The EA uses the MQL5 Standard Library CExpert/CExpertSignal framework. Entry/exit logic is determined by the CML_MFI custom signal filter class (in ACML_MFI.mqh) which votes with a weight of 1.0. The signal threshold system means: open when weighted vote >= 40 (ThresholdOpen), close when weighted vote >= 20 (ThresholdClose) in opposite direction. The CML_MFI class likely computes MFI values, applies an MA smooth, and generates buy/sell votes based on MFI crossing its MA or MFI reaching overbought/oversold levels. Exact logic requires reading ACML_MFI.mqh. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing only on new bar completion, not every tick.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACML_MFI.mqh to extract the exact CML_MFI::LongCondition() and CML_MFI::ShortCondition() methods. These methods contain the actual crossover/threshold logic for MFI vs its MA. The CExpert framework handles position management, so Python conversion needs to replicate: (1) MFI calculation, (2) MA-on-MFI smoothing, (3) voting/threshold system for open/close, (4) bar-on-close execution model. SL/TP are both 0 so exits are purely signal-driven. Pending order expiration of 4 bars is set but no pending orders are created (market execution).
